descriptionByLocale.en:
The University Children's Hospital of Basel (UKBB) is the university competence centre for paediatric and adolescent medicine as well as for teaching and research in Northwestern Switzerland. The Center Neuroorthopaedics and Clinical Motion Analysis (NeOMo) in Basel is one of Switzerland’s leading institutions for clinical movement analysis. As an interdisciplinary team, we combine state-of-the-art technologies with clinical expertise and innovative research to bring about lasting improvements in the care of children and adolescents with movement disorders.

Eintrittsdatum : From 1. September 2026\n\n\nIhre Aufgaben\n\n

• Participation to human movement data collection and processing of patients' data in the gait laboratory

• Analysis and interpretation of individual patient datasets

• Maintenance and further development of software for the analysis of clinical data and generation of clinical reports

• Participation to laboratory meetings, including patient's case presentation, data Interpretation, communication with surgeons, providing technical references for correct clinical decision-making

• Participation to scientific projects relevant to the routine clinical work and to the research interests of the group and in line with current trends within the scientific community

• Participation to scientific dissemination through relevant scientific conferences and publishing of papers in important peer-reviewed journals

• Support of students, in the context of defined research questions of the UKBB group

• Provide technical and scientific support to research projects of other team members

\n\n\nIhr Profil\n\n

• You are a biomechanical or biomedical engineer or a graduate human movement scientist with experience in motion analysis

• You have good programming skills in Python or Matlab

• You have experience and are interested in musculo-skeletal modelling

• The successful candidate is pragmatic, is able to multitask, problem solving oriented and can work independently in a team environment

• Communication skills in oral and written English are essential as well as communication skills in oral German are essential

\n\n\nUnser Angebot\n\n

• A highly interdisciplinary, international, diverse, and supportive team

• Flexible working hours and attractive working conditions

• Opportunities to participate in research and teaching projects

• Future career development opportunities in a scientific and academic environment

• Work at a leading center of excellence with close ties between clinical practice and research
